# oxide_parse

> Declarative HTML, XML & JSON extractor: Python DSL (`T`) -> JSON IR -> Rust plan (`stream`, `lite`/`scraper`, `xml`, `json`), Zero-IO `Session`, self-healing `adaptive` selectors.

## DSL & Compilation Rules

- Import: `from oxide_parse import T, compile, follow, paginate, if_, coalesce`
- Compile once: `plan = compile(schema, backend="auto")` (`auto`, `stream`, `lite`, `scraper`, `xml`, `json`), then `plan.extract(doc, meta={"base_url": ...})`.
- Null-safe: missing -> `None`. `.default(v)` falls back, `.required()` fails.
- `.text()`, `.attr()`, `.html()` read the **first** node; use `.map({...})` for lists (`on_error="skip"|"null"` quarantines bad rows).
- Never use Python `if/else`, `and/or/not`, `for`, `try/except` in `schema`; use `&`, `|`, `~`, `if_(c, t, o)`, `coalesce(a, b)`.
- Stay in `stream` (`backend="auto"`): avoid `xpath`, `parent`, `filter`, `+`, `~`, `:has`, `:contains`, `:last-child`, `adaptive`.

## Operations (`T`)

- Navigation: `css(sel, adaptive=key, threshold=0.5)` `:scope > .c` `xpath(expr)` `first()` `last()` `at(i)` `[i]` `[a:b]` `slice(a, b)` `rest()` `parent()` `children()` `root()` `key(k)` `["k"]`
- Extraction: `text(sep, strip, without, br, deep)` `own_text()` `own_texts()` `table(mode)` `main_content()` `attr()` `has_attr()` `html()` `inner_html()` `markdown()` `distill()` `meta()`
- Strings & types: `strip()` `lower()` `upper()` `replace(a, b)` `split(sep)` `join(sep)` `regex(pat, g)` `regex_all(pat, g)` `int()` `float()` `price()` `parse_srcset(pick)` `bool()` `url(base)` `link_header(rel)`
- Hybrid & flat: `parse_json()` `parse_html(s)` `js_json(var)` `json_ld(type, resolve_refs)` `microdata(type)` `next_flight(key)` `meta_tags()` `sections()` `group_by()` `kv(label)`
- Collections & logic: `count()` `exists()` `map(body, on_error=None)` `flat_map(body)` `filter(pred)` `unique(by=None, keep="first")` `default(v)` `required()` `non_empty()` `coalesce(*alts)` `eq` `ne` `contains` `startswith` `endswith` `not_()` `and_()` `or_()` `if_(c, t, o)`
- I/O, codecs & crawl: `Plan.dumps/loads/dump/load` (`json`, `yaml`, `toml`, `python`, `register_format`) `follow` `paginate` `crawl`/`acrawl` `extract_jsonl`/`extract_csv` `migrate.patch_crawl4ai_prompt()`
